stories.title: Valve will finally let you build your own Steam Machine with SteamOS for desktop
stories.summary: If you don't get lucky with Valve's Steam Machine reservation system, you can make your own Steam Machine instead. Valve says that "starting with the SteamOS 3.8 release, you can put together your own Steam Machine using whatever PC parts you want." stories.title: Our sun is destined to 'kick and spit' its way across the solar system when it dies
stories.summary: Scientists have discovered that dying stars don't go down without a fight, with red giants spitting out blobs of plasma and receiving a corresponding "kick."

stories.title: Make science more reliable: study people as they go about their lives
